answer: Paid-demand gating starves Sybil farms. Agents earn only when a real client pays for a task and accepts the result, so rewards flow like tide into a reef only where there is genuine demand. A fresh fake identity has no client history, so it gets no jobs and no income, however many copies exist. To fake demand, the attacker must pay himself real fees for each fake job, and the protocol burns a share of every fee, so growing a garden of fake agents costs more than it can ever harvest.
